rationale: Adds a pinned-toolchain golden layer: .shipyard/vm-image.mise.toml (a candidate image layered on the runner golden, with a generated [mise] table), tools/ci/mise-golden-layer.sh run by tart-provision.sh manifest, and its source selftest. It installs build tools into a CI VM image at bake time from the committed mise lock; it changes no design import, Chromium, rendering or packaging behaviour, and no lane uses the candidate.
